item.tib: gsang sngags ma rgyud tshogs kyi lag len bde bar ston pa blo dman ngal 'tsho'i snang byed
item.coloph: rnam 'dren brtse chen ma ma thugs kyi bcud/ gus zhus lag len 'o ma'i rgyan bzang 'di/ mos 'jug zho 'thung rnams kyi gsos yin gyis/ log rtog lce gnyis smra ba'i spod yul min/ bdag blo rmongs pas don la 'gal srid na/ skyabs gnas dpyod ldan (rnams) la bzod par gsol/ 'di spel dge ba'i bdag sogs rjes 'breng bcas/ sngags lam myur bsgrod phyag rgya che thob shog gshen gyi drang srong shI la d+ha dza yis/ sku 'bum rigs byed khang du sbyar//
